reason: Thirty-six dollars for a tinted balm from a brand I've never heard of, with zero reviews, is a lot to gamble on lips that react to half of what I put on them. The guarantee is nice, but a refund doesn't undo a rash or another week of peeling lips.
objection: I can't see from an ad what's actually in it. These color-changing balms usually have a dye and often fragrance or flavor, and that's exactly what sets my lips off. Then there's 'stays moisturizing,' which every lipstick in my drawer also promised.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the full ingredient list up front with no fragrance, flavoring or the usual irritants, plus a handful of honest reviews from women my age with sensitive lips saying it didn't dry or burn.
